get_branch_class_by_name: get a Branch class from the registry by name such as randomly_prune or retrain
list_registered_branches: list all registered branch names in the registered_branches dictionary
review_get_function: review the get function that retrieves a Branch class from the registry by name
review_registered_branches_dict: review the registered_branches dictionary that maps branch names to Branch classes
refactor_get_function: refactor the get function to return a default Branch class when the name is not found
